findings.finding: Real estate work in Dubai is described as hectic, potentially impacting social connections.
findings.qualification: This is self-reported and reflects personal experience.

findings.finding: Mantras and personal motivational tools are used by individuals to navigate challenges in their career paths.
Coaching positively impacted career development for individuals previously engaged in real estate.
Training resources and online academies are considered beneficial for career development in real estate.
Belief in oneself and addressing self-limiting beliefs are considered crucial for career development.
Bankruptcy is mentioned as a personal challenge within the real estate profession.
findings.qualification: Self-reported without detailed context or resolution.

findings.finding: Improving fundamental skills rather than pursuing new interests is advised for career success.
findings.qualification: Advice given without supporting evidence of efficacy.

findings.finding: Tracking activities systematically in real estate is important for effective client management.
findings.qualification: Advice on systematic management without performance metrics.
